university.name: Robert Gordon University
university.summary: Robert Gordon University is based in Aberdeen, Scotland. Its postal address is Garthdee House, Garthdee Road, Aberdeen, AB10 7QB.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.award: MSc (with PgCert and PgDip exit awards)
courses.duration_text: 12 months full-time from September, 17 months full-time from January (placement extends duration); part-time options also listed
courses.overview: Taught master's in data science for graduates in mathematics, statistics, computing or another analytical discipline, delivered on campus or part-time online. The page directs readers to the course and module explorer for module detail.
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a 2:2 undergraduate honours degree or equivalent in Mathematics, Statistics, Computing or another analytical discipline. Lower classifications and relevant work experience are considered case by case.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component lower than 5.5, or an equivalent test. The Pakistan page says most postgraduate courses require 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each area, so confirm with RGU.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: A 4 year bachelor's degree from a university recognised by the Pakistan Higher Education Commission with CGPA 2.5 on a 4-point scale (or 3.5 on a 5-point scale), or 60 to 69%. A master's degree needs a minimum of 60% overall. A small number of programmes require an upper second.
courses.application_deadline_note: The page says application deadlines are in place which may affect first choice of start date or course.
courses.notes: Only the 2026/27 international fee is published on the course page; target year fee not yet published. Fee shown is full-time on-campus Year 1. Page lists no modules, so highlights are empty. English minimum conflicts with the Pakistan page (6.5 for most postgraduate courses); course page value used.

courses.title: Oil and Gas Engineering
courses.award: MSc (with PgCert and PgDip exit awards)
courses.duration_text: 12 months full-time from September, 16 months full-time from January; online part-time also listed
courses.overview: Taught master's in oil and gas engineering for engineering graduates, with PgCert and PgDip exit points and an individual project in the final term. Available on campus full-time or online part-time.
courses.academic_requirements: Normally a 2:2 undergraduate honours degree or equivalent in Engineering. Lower classifications and relevant work experience are considered case by case.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component lower than 5.5, or an equivalent test. The Pakistan page says most postgraduate courses require 6.5 overall with 5.5 in each area, so confirm with RGU.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: A 4 year bachelor's degree from a university recognised by the Pakistan Higher Education Commission with CGPA 2.5 on a 4-point scale (or 3.5 on a 5-point scale), or 60 to 69%. A master's degree needs a minimum of 60% overall. A small number of programmes require an upper second.
courses.application_deadline_note: The page says application deadlines are in place which may affect first choice of start date or course.
courses.notes: Only the 2026/27 international fee is published on the course page; target year fee not yet published. Fee shown is full-time on-campus. Page does not say which modules are compulsory or optional, and its Term 1 list is introduced with 'such as'. Page text says 1 year full-time while its table shows 16 months for January starts.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 4 years full-time, or 4 years plus 1 year placement
courses.overview: Four-year full-time honours degree on campus with a common first year, an optional industry placement or study abroad year, and a final-year collaborative project with industrial clients. Applicants without direct entry grades can use the International College.
highlights: Internet of Things and AI topics (year 4)
courses.academic_requirements: Year 1 entry: SQA Higher BBCC plus two passes including English and Maths at National 5 grade C; A Level CCC plus two passes, English and Maths at GCSE grade 5 if not held at A Level; IB Diploma 26 points. Year 2 entry: A Level BBC including Computing or another numerate subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, or an equivalent qualification. Some courses may require a higher standard.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Qualifications from any international high school are expected to be comparable to UK results. A 2 or 3 year bachelor's degree with a minimum score of 59.5% will be considered. Applicants without an international high school qualification are expected to take a pathway programme through the International College.
courses.uk_min_alevels: CCC and two further passes (Year 1 entry)
courses.notes: Only the 2026/27 international fee is published on the course page; target year fee not yet published. Page lists January (via International College) and September starts without a year, so intake_labels is empty. Module names are not listed on the page, only year summaries, and compulsory or optional status is not stated. UCAS code G400.

courses.title: Business and Management
courses.overview: Four-year full-time honours degree on campus covering marketing, finance, human resource management and economics in year 1, with year 3 options including a placement or study abroad, and an independent thesis in year 4.
courses.academic_requirements: Year 1 entry: SQA Higher BBBC; A Level BCC; Irish Leaving Certificate H2H3H3H3; IB Diploma 27. Year 2 entry: A Level BBB. Applicants not meeting direct entry can gain extra entry points through the International College.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, or an equivalent. Some courses may require a higher standard.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Qualifications from any international high school are expected to be comparable to UK results. A 2 or 3 year bachelor's degree with a minimum score of 59.5% will be considered. Applicants without an international high school qualification are expected to take a pathway programme through the International College.
courses.notes: Only the 2026/27 international fee is published on the course page; target year fee not yet published. Page lists January (via International College) and September starts without a year, so intake_labels is empty. Page does not state compulsory or optional status for modules. UCAS code N201.

scholarships.name: RGU International Merit-based Scholarship for Master's Students
scholarships.value_text: GBP 8,000 discount on postgraduate fees, less any other RGU scholarships already assigned
scholarships.summary: Fee discount for self-funding international students holding an offer for a full-time on-campus master's starting in September 2027, who have the equivalent of a first class honours degree. Three awards are available.
scholarships.criteria_text: Equivalent of a first class honours undergraduate degree; self-funding, international fee-paying; offer for a full-time on-campus postgraduate course starting September 2027, with all offer conditions met by the deadline.
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications for September 2027 are open now and close on 1 June 2027.
scholarships.notes: Page states all countries are eligible; Pakistan is not named but is listed for this award on the RGU Pakistan page.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.summary: First-year tuition award for self-funding international undergraduates entering year 1 or year 2 of a full-time on-campus course in September 2027, selected on academic merit, community engagement and extra-curricular activities.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer for a full-time on-campus undergraduate course for September 2027; international fee payer, self-funding; all conditions except deposit met by the deadline; selection by academic merit, community engagement and extra-curricular activities; recipient acts as an RGU ambassador.
scholarships.deadline_note: Applications for September 2027 close on 1 June 2027.
scholarships.notes: Monetary value is the first year's tuition fee, so value_amount is null.

scholarships.name: RGU International Student Discount for Master's Students
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 to 4,000 discount towards master's tuition fees (GBP 4,000 for students from Kenya, Indonesia and Nepal; GBP 3,000 for other listed countries)
scholarships.summary: Tuition discount for self-funding international fee-paying students on full-time on-campus master's courses who meet the entry requirements. No separate application; any award is shown in the letter of offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: Eligible for an RGU offer on standard or advertised entry requirements; international fee payer; self-funding; full-time on-campus postgraduate study. One RGU award per programme, the higher discount applied.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline or entry year stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Page says all countries are eligible but does not state the amount for Pakistan, so value_amount is null. Page also says the award is at the university's discretion and granted on enrolment.

scholarships.name: RGU International Student Discount for Undergraduate Students
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 discount on each year of undergraduate tuition fees
scholarships.summary: Annual tuition discount for self-funding international fee-paying students starting year one in September on full-time on-campus undergraduate courses. No separate application; any award is shown in the letter of offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: Eligible for an RGU offer on standard or advertised entry requirements; international fee payer; self-funding; full-time on-campus; year one September start. One RGU award per programme, the higher discount applied.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated on the page.
scholarships.notes: Page names no year for the September start. Awarded at the university's discretion upon enrolment.
